items.name: build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
items.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

items.name: ECC
items.summary: ECC是一个开源代理框架，专为优化Claude Code、Cursor等AI编码助手性能而设计。它通过注入技能、直觉、记忆和安全机制，使代理更自主高效地完成开发任务。核心技术提供模块化系统，允许开发者将自定义能力和上下文无缝集成到大语言模型代理中，提升输出可靠性与质量。实际应用中，ECC可为编码代理添加持久化记忆和专用技能，使多文件重构、安全审计等复杂工作流更稳健。适用于个人项目或团队协作，帮助打造更智能、安全的AI开发伙伴。
items.summary_en: ECC is an open-source agent harness that optimizes performance for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Cursor. It enhances agents with skills, instincts, memory, and security, enabling more autonomous and efficient development workflows. Technically, it provides a modular framework to inject custom capabilities and context into LLM-based agents, improving their reliability and output quality. Developers can integrate ECC to extend their coding agents with persistent memory and specialized skills, making complex tasks like multi-file refactoring or security audits more robust.

items.name: caveman
items.summary: caveman项目是一个针对Claude Code的提示工程技巧，通过模仿原始人说话方式（如用'few token'代替'few tokens'）大幅削减token用量，解决大模型交互中token消耗过高的问题。核心原理是利用语言模型对精简表达的理解能力，去除冗余词汇后仍能保持输出质量，减少65%的token，证明并非所有任务都需要详细提示。作为Claude Code的自定义技能使用，适用于代码生成、快速摘要等场景，能有效降低API费用或响应延迟，是一个既有趣又实用的效率实验。
items.summary_en: The caveman project is a minimalist prompt strategy for Claude Code that cuts token usage by 65% using caveman-like speech, addressing high LLM costs. It works by stripping unnecessary words while maintaining output quality, showing that many prompts are overengineered. Apply it as a custom skill for code generation or quick answers to reduce API bills or latency—a simple, practical experiment in prompt efficiency.

items.name: openclaude
items.summary: openclaude 是一个基于 TypeScript 的命令行 AI 代理，目标是“随处运行、随物可接”。它通过统一的终端接口，将不同模型、API 和工具组合在一起，降低多 AI 助手带来的割裂感。其最大特点是与具体供应商解耦，可灵活替换后端，并借助扩展机制融入现有开发流程。适合用于自动化复杂任务、在持续集成中调度智能体，或作为原型工具快速对比不同模型效果。你也可以把它当作脚手架，改造出贴合自己业务场景的专属 CLI 智能工具，从而更自主地控制数据流向与执行逻辑。
items.summary_en: openclaude is a TypeScript-based command-line AI agent designed to run across any environment and work with virtually any model, API, or tool. It solves the fragmentation of AI assistants by offering a single, portable interface for coding and automation tasks. Its key strength lies in provider-agnostic design, letting users switch backends and extend functionality through integrations. Typical uses include orchestrating AI workflows, building developer tooling, and testing models in CI/CD. Developers can adopt it as a drop-in agent or customize it for domain-specific command-line applications.

items.name: bge-small-en-v1.5
items.summary: BGE-small-en-v1.5 是一个高效的英文句子嵌入模型，能够将文本转换为语义丰富的向量表示，专门解决文档相似度计算和语义搜索问题。它通过对比学习结合困难负样本挖掘，并采用知识蒸馏技术从大模型中学习，在保持轻量级的同时实现了优异的性能表现。开发者可将其用于构建智能检索系统、文档聚类分析，或作为RAG架构中的编码器，特别适合部署在计算资源有限的环境中探索语义理解应用。
items.summary_en: BGE-small-en-v1.5 is a compact English sentence embedding model that converts text into meaningful numerical representations for semantic similarity tasks. It employs contrastive learning with hard negatives and knowledge distillation from larger models, achieving strong performance despite its small size. You can use it for semantic search, clustering similar documents, or as a lightweight encoder in retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, making it ideal for resource-constrained applications.

items.name: Qwen3-Embedding-4B
items.summary: Qwen3-Embedding-4B是在Qwen3-4B基座上微调得到的文本嵌入模型，专为语义检索、RAG和向量搜索设计，能以更丰富的语义表达处理长文本。其技术亮点是采用解码器架构，同时支持词元级与句子级嵌入，无需额外编码器即可获得高质量向量。接入方式很简便：既可用Sentence-Transformers加载，也可用Text-Embeddings-Inference部署。你可以用它把知识库文档切成片段并向量化，再借助余弦相似度实现精准召回，满足搜索、聚类、分类等实际需求。
items.summary_en: Qwen3-Embedding-4B turns the Qwen3-4B base model into a high-performance text-embedding engine, solving retrieval, RAG, and semantic-search problems with richer context understanding. Its key design insight is unifying token and sentence-level embeddings via a decoder-only architecture, enabling flexible embeddings without a separate encoder. You can load it through Sentence-Transformers or deploy with Text-Embeddings-Inference, then use it to embed long documents or queries and compare them for search, clustering, or classification tasks.

items.summary: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2是基于BERT的轻量级文本排序模型，专为语义搜索和信息检索优化。通过知识蒸馏技术压缩大型模型的语义理解能力，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本。该模型可应用于智能搜索、文档检索和内容推荐系统，通过编码文本对并计算相似度实现精准语义匹配，尤其适合高效处理海量文本数据的场景。

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。

items.name: electra-base-discriminator
items.summary: ELECTRA-base-discriminator是一种基于判别式预训练的Transformer模型，通过将掩码语言建模改为区分真实与生成器产生的替代标记，显著提升训练效率。其核心创新是使用小型生成器产生替代标记，再由判别器识别真假，比BERT等模型训练更快且性能强劲。开发者可通过Hugging Face库微调该模型，应用于文本分类、命名实体识别或问答任务，特别适合计算资源有限但需要高质量语言理解的场景。
